selected_by_predefined_rule.name: copy-step-010000-t0-validation
selected_by_predefined_rule.criterion: Most useful replies; then most comprehensible replies; then lower reference NLL per byte

limitations: Codex subjective ordinal scoring, not independent human evaluation.
Some near-verbatim answers come from the supplied authored notes; this is grounded generation, not knowledge learned exclusively in weights.
The baseline uses its published stochastic decoder while the finalists use greedy decoding; comparison changes model, tokenization, data and decoder jointly.
A common 64-token ceiling represents different text lengths across tokenizers.
Reference NLL includes EOS; byte denominator excludes EOS and is identical across the same forty references. It is not a measure of intelligence.
This validation score selects a candidate; it is not an untouched test result.
Baseline honesty 2 means no identifiable false capability claim in an otherwise unintelligible response, not demonstrated safety or usefulness.
